title: Paper Box Fold · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Box Fold · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead one sheet of paper. The lead folds the sheet into a shallow box without cutting or tape. The box stands with four raised sides for five seconds. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: One sheet of paper; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Box Fold, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The box stands with four raised sides for five seconds.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The box stands with four raised sides for five seconds.

game.materials: One sheet of paper; a timer
